page.layout: One printed page, single column of running text. Running head at top centre. Page number top right. Marginal note number "8." in the right margin beside the second paragraph. Heading block in the middle of the page. Drop-cap initial G opens the body. Signature-like word "Sunt" at the lower right, a catchword.

main_text.p: est rerum, quarum in ijsdem artibus præcipuus est usus, naturam, uim atq; effectus, penitus explorare.

Octauo & postremò, Etiamsi neq; in Theologia, neq; in medicina, neq; in ullo omnino doctrinæ genere grauiori uersari liberet: tamen ingens uoluptas, quam in uniuscuiusque animo suggerit rerum naturalium cognitio & contemplatio, merito excitare omnes deberet ad hanc parte philosophiæ perdiscendam.8.
main_text.head: PRIMA PARS PHYSICES, de Principijs.
Explana argumentum octo librorum Aristotelis de Principijs, seu de Auscultatione physica.
main_text.p: GEneratim quidem sic habet. Sicut in unaquaq; disciplina quædam principia seu loci communes proponuntur, quos tenere oportet, antequam ad altiora fiat progressus (uidemus namque in artibus mathematicis, item in Theologia & Iurisprudentia cæterisq; id fieri) ita in philosophia naturali sunt quidam loci communes scitu pernecessarij omnibus qui exactè cupiunt aliquando de quarumcunq; rerum naturis disputare. Hi igitur in illis octo libris explicantur.

page.notes: The printed drop-cap G is joined to "Eneratim" as "GEneratim". The word "Sunt" at the lower right is a catchword. The marginal note "8." is a bare section number. Some words in the body are faint; "Hi igitur" ends the paragraph and "Sunt" is the catchword for the next page. Line "est rerum" at top is a continuation fragment. Lines near "cupiunt aliquando" are slightly uncertain: the printed text reads "aliquan do" split across the line break, rendered here as "aliquando" with the hyphen absent.
